newsitem.title: CHINA: China electronics sector output value rises in H1.
newsitem.headline: China electronics sector output value rises in H1.

text.p: The output value of China's electronics sector hit 162.62 billion yuan ($19.6 billion) in the first half of 1997, up 26.5 percent compared with the same period last year, Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
The sector's pretax profits in January-June were 7.2 billion yuan, up 27.4 percent compared with the same period last year, Xinhua said.

Production of major electronic products rose in January-June with output of microcomputers totalling 650,000 units, up 27.5 percent year-on-year, and output of colour televisions reaching 10.44 million units, up 12 percent year-on-year, it said.
The sales to output ratio in the period was about 94 percent and sales were expected to reach 99.0 billion yuan, up more than 18 percent compared with the same period last year, it said.
Customs statistics showed exports of electronic products in the first half hit $11.0 billion, up 24 percent year-on-year, it said.
